label: Term of the agreement
description: how long the agreement lasts or when it ends

label: Termination notice
description: written notice needed to terminate the agreement

label: Governing law
description: which state or country law governs the agreement

label: Written confirmation of oral disclosures
description: time allowed to identify oral disclosures as confidential in writing

label: Payment terms
description: amount, rate or schedule of payment for the services

label: Non-compete
description: whether the agreement contains a non-compete clause
